title: PowerShell/wsmprovhost opened LSASS with full-access masks on SCRANTON and NASHUA
rationale: All describe the same action: PowerShell.exe (PID 2976/3852, pbeesly) on scranton and wsmprovhost.exe on nashua opening lsass.exe with 0x1f3fff/0x1fffff. F16/F48 note absence of cracking/forged-ticket evidence but the LSASS access itself is the shared event; best fit is LSASS memory access (T1003.001).

title: PowerShell Get-Keystrokes keylogger on SCRANTON
rationale: Keystroke-Check/Get-Keystrokes PowerShell keylogging session by pbeesly; T1056.001.

title: Invoke-ScreenCapture screen capture loop on SCRANTON
rationale: Invoke-ScreenCapture grabbing the virtual screen to .bmp files; GUI input capture T1056.002.

title: No offline cracking or hive dumping; SAM accesses are normal lsass behavior
rationale: Finding documents absence of mimikatz/procdump/reg save and normal SAM access, while host is under hands-on-keyboard attack; no cracking observed, so assessed suspicious under T1110.002 as the closest in-scope technique evaluated.

title: Invoke-Exfil: 7z archive of Downloads copied to WebDAV share with NTLM auth
rationale: Same Invoke-Exfil script block (psversion.ps1) compressing Downloads to OfficeSupplies.7z and copying to \\192.168.0.4\webdav, with NTLM authentication to the WebDAV host; forced authentication T1187.

title: Credential-named file harvesting and password-protected archive staging on NASHUA
rationale: Collection script targeting *pass*/*login*/*admin*/*vpn/*sifr files, Rar archiving with password, and PsExec64 with cleartext password pushing python.exe; credentials-in-files harvesting fits T1552.001.

title: Get-PrivateKeys exported LocalMachine certificates to PFX files on SCRANTON
rationale: Same Get-PrivateKeys script block (readme.ps1) exporting cert:\LocalMachine to password-protected .pfx in Downloads; F26 also covers the same session's credential tooling. Private key/certificate theft fits T1552.004.

title: Kerberoast-style krbtgt TGS request by pbeesly
rationale: 4769 TGS request for krbtgt service by pbeesly with Kerberoast-like ticket options; T1558.003.

title: Certificate store write on NASHUA during pbeesly session
rationale: Same SystemCertificates write under systemprofile on nashua at 03:16:19; certificate store access fits T1649.

title: PsExec service installs and offensive PowerShell toolkit (lateral movement/execution)
rationale: PSEXESVC installs and PowerShell exfil/screen-capture scripts reflect lateral movement via SMB/admin shares, not credential access.

title: SMB/NTLM logon consistent with PsExec lateral movement, not relay
rationale: SMB connections from System process and the NTLM network logon are the PsExec session authentication; no relay/poisoning observed.

title: Masqueraded .scr loader, steganographic payload, csc compile and anti-forensics on SCRANTON
rationale: Loader execution, in-memory compilation, UAC-bypass binary and sdelete cleanup are execution/defense-evasion actions, not credential access.
